def comps(g):

def transform(grid):
    bg=collections.Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(grid)
    large=[x for x in cc if len(x['cells'])>=9]
    large.sort(key=lambda x:min(r for r,c in x['cells']))
    pieces=[x for x in cc if x not in large and len(x['cells'])>1]

    blocks=[]; holes=set()
    for x in large:
      cells=x['cells']; rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
      mr,mc=min(rs),min(cs); h=max(rs)-mr+1; w=max(cs)-mc+1

    out=[row for b in blocks for row in b]
    placements=[]
    for i,p in enumerate(pieces):
      shape=norm(p['cells']); opts=[]
      for r,c in holes:
       for sr,sc in shape:
        dr,dc=r-sr,c-sc
        placed=frozenset((a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in shape)
        if placed<=holes:opts.append(placed)
      placements.append(set(opts))
    # exact cover search, pieces used once
    best=None
    def rec(remaining,used,assigned):
      nonlocal best
      if not remaining:
       if used==holes:best=assigned;return True
       return False
      # choose most constrained remaining piece
      i=min(remaining,key=lambda j:sum(not (p & used) for p in placements[j]))
